source: Finder diagnostic DOM snapshot supplied by owner in chat
visible_captcha_instruction: Иногда такое случается, чтобы вернуться на сайт нажмите на кнопку Продолжить для решения капчи
interpretation: The third observed surface is not a pure classifier false positive: both explicit IP restriction and a real CAPTCHA gate are visible. The hard CAPTCHA boundary is therefore applicable once this surface exists. The relevant defect is earlier in the recovery strategy: the first pure-IP-block attempt does not force provider rotation even when the selected provider profile exposes a safe change_ip_link, so a fresh Avito request can escalate to CAPTCHA before stronger rotation is attempted.
